description: This file defines a SwiftUI view component called OpenClawChatView, which manages the display and interaction for a chat interface in a SwiftUI application. It includes state management, layout, message rendering, error handling, and auxiliary views related to chat messages.

classes.name: OpenClawChatView
classes.description: A SwiftUI View representing a chat interface, supporting different styles and rendering messages, handling loading states, errors, and managing scroll behavior.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializer to create OpenClawChatView with configurable parameters such as viewModel, style, markdownVariant, userAccent, and showsAssistantTrace.

methods.name: body
methods.description: The main view composition, including message list, composer, and conditional overlays.

methods.name: messageList
methods.description: Constructs the scrollable list of chat messages and elements like loading indicator and overlays.

methods.name: messageListRows
methods.description: ViewBuilder assembling individual message bubbles and auxiliary indicators.

methods.name: mergeToolResults
methods.description: Merges tool result messages with previous messages based on tool call IDs.

methods.name: isToolResultMessage
methods.description: Checks if a message has role indicating it's a tool result.

methods.name: shouldDisplayMessage
methods.description: Decides if a message should be visible based on its content and other internal states.

methods.name: primaryText
methods.description: Extracts the main text from a message's content.

methods.name: hasInlineAttachments
methods.description: Determines if a message contains inline file or attachment content.

methods.name: toolCalls
methods.description: Returns content blocks related to tool calls within a message.

methods.name: inlineToolResults
methods.description: Returns content blocks indicating inline tool results within a message.

methods.name: toolCallIds
methods.description: Collects all tool call IDs associated with a message.

methods.name: toolResultText
methods.description: Gets the text associated with a tool result message.

methods.name: dismissKeyboardIfNeeded
methods.description: programmatically dismisses the keyboard if UIKit is available.

methods.name: errorPresentation
methods.description: Creates a presentation structure (title, icon, color) based on error string content.
